studies.title: Sorghum
studies.caption: Dense seed heads rise above sorghum's broad leaves. Its ability to grow in hot, dry country helped it become a staple across Africa and beyond.
studies.prompt: Low-angle close field study of Sorghum bicolor in dry Sudanese savanna cultivation, stout stems, broad blade leaves, dense branching reddish-brown grain panicles with many round grains. Dry earth and hazy grassland, no maize cobs or wheat awns, no machinery.
